_comment: PhantomNet Sprint Config — Week 19 (Month 5 Week 3: Batch Operations & PDF Export, Days 31-35)
milestone_description: Implementation of local LLM narrative integration, TAXII feed server, MITRE ATT&CK visualization, PDF export, and batch operations.

tasks.Title: Add Batch Approve and Reject API Endpoints
tasks.Objective: Add batch approve/reject API endpoints in FastAPI backend to allow operations on multiple playbooks simultaneously.
Tasks: Create POST /api/sentinel/playbooks/batch/approve accepting a list of playbook IDs.
Create POST /api/sentinel/playbooks/batch/reject accepting a list of playbook IDs.
Implement batch transaction processing and error handling for partial failures.
Deliverables: POST /api/sentinel/playbooks/batch/approve and POST /api/sentinel/playbooks/batch/reject working endpoints in backend/api/sentinel.py.

tasks.Title: Evaluate PDF Export Approaches and Dependencies
tasks.Objective: Evaluate client-side vs server-side PDF export libraries for playbook documentation generation.
Tasks: Evaluate client-side PDF generation with jspdf + jspdf-autotable.
Evaluate Python fallback options (reportlab / weasyprint) if client-side rendering lacks formatting quality.
Document technical decisions and styling guidelines for PDF playbook reports.
Deliverables: Architecture decision note and setup for PDF export in docs/pdf_export_design.md.

tasks.Title: Add Playbook Versioning and Revision History Storage
tasks.Objective: Add version tracking database schema and logic so regenerated playbooks maintain full revision history.
Tasks: Add version column and parent references to SentinelPlaybook database model in backend/models/sentinel.py.
Update playbook generation workflow to increment version number upon re-generation.
Ensure historical versions remain retrievable via database query filters.
Deliverables: Database migration and version history tracking in SentinelPlaybook model.

tasks.Title: Add Multi-Select Checkboxes to Playbook List Component
tasks.Objective: Enhance Sentinel Dashboard playbook list with multi-selection support for batch actions.
Tasks: Add selection checkboxes to playbook item cards/rows in PlaybookList.jsx.
Implement header multi-select toggle (Select All / Deselect All).
Display floating batch action toolbar when one or more playbooks are selected.
Deliverables: Multi-select UI state and checkbox components in frontend-dev/src/components/sentinel/PlaybookList.jsx.

tasks.Title: Add Search and Filter Capabilities to Sentinel API
tasks.Objective: Implement comprehensive query parameters on playbook listing API for keyword search, technique, severity, and date range filtering.
Tasks: Add query parameters search, technique, severity, date_from, date_to to GET /api/sentinel/playbooks.
Build SQL query filters using SQLAlchemy filters/ILIKE patterns.
Optimize search indexes and pagination bounds.
Deliverables: Filtered API search endpoint supporting multi-criteria queries.

tasks.Title: Build PDF Generator Function for Playbook Export
tasks.Objective: Create PDF rendering function that converts Markdown playbooks into clean, styled PDF documents with PhantomNet branding.
Tasks: Implement PDF generation builder generate_pdf(playbook_markdown) -> bytes.
Apply custom PhantomNet header/footer styling, executive summary styling, and MITRE code block formatting.
Validate proper pagination, page numbers, and dynamic table bounds.
Deliverables: PDF generator module in backend/sentinel/pdf_exporter.py or frontend export builder.

tasks.Title: Build Automated Sentinel Generation Scheduler Service
tasks.Objective: Implement automated background task scheduler to trigger periodic sentinel playbook generation.
Tasks: Integrate periodic background task with backend/services/scheduler_service.py to trigger sentinel pipeline every N minutes.
Add configuration flags SENTINEL_AUTO_GEN_ENABLED and SENTINEL_AUTO_GEN_INTERVAL_MINUTES.
Ensure background execution handles locking to avoid concurrent generation collisions.
Deliverables: Periodic playbook auto-generation service integrated into background scheduler.

tasks.Title: Add Search Bar and Advanced Filters to Sentinel Dashboard
tasks.Objective: Connect UI search bar and dropdown filter controls to the search/filter backend API.
Tasks: Build keyword search input field with debounce mechanism in SentinelDashboard.jsx.
Add dropdown filter selectors for Severity, Status, and MITRE Technique.
Update state management to refetch playbook list on filter change.
Deliverables: Responsive search bar and filter dropdown bar in Sentinel Dashboard UI.

tasks.Title: Implement Dashboard Analytics and Stats API Endpoints
tasks.Objective: Build aggregated statistics API endpoints returning metrics on playbooks by severity, approval rate, confidence, and generation trends.
Tasks: Create GET /api/sentinel/stats endpoint returning summary aggregate numbers.
Compute distributions for severity, status, average confidence score, and daily generation counts.
Ensure fast execution with SQL aggregation queries.
Deliverables: GET /api/sentinel/stats returning structured JSON analytics object.

tasks.Title: Integrate PDF Export Endpoint into FastAPI Sentinel API
tasks.Objective: Expose endpoint allowing users to download playbooks in PDF format.
Tasks: Create POST /api/sentinel/playbooks/{id}/export?format=pdf endpoint.
Return response as stream/blob with Content-Type: application/pdf and Content-Disposition attachment header.
Add error handling for non-existent playbooks or generation failures.
Deliverables: Working PDF export endpoint in backend/api/sentinel.py.

tasks.Title: Add Email Notification System for Critical Playbook Generation
tasks.Objective: Trigger email alerts when high-severity or CRITICAL playbooks are automatically generated.
Tasks: Integrate email notification dispatcher with SystemConfig settings.
Compose alert email template containing playbook title, severity, summary, and direct dashboard link.
Trigger email sending asynchronously on CRITICAL playbook creation.
Deliverables: Email alert dispatcher integrated into playbook creation event listener.

tasks.Title: Build Sentinel Dashboard Stats and Analytics Panel
tasks.Objective: Implement visual charts and analytics cards displaying playbook metrics on the Sentinel Dashboard.
Tasks: Create SentinelStatsPanel.jsx component.
Render summary count cards (Total, Approved, Pending, Rejected).
Render pie/bar charts for severity distribution, approval rate, and generation timeline using chart library or SVG.
Deliverables: frontend-dev/src/components/sentinel/SentinelStatsPanel.jsx integrated into Sentinel Dashboard.

tasks.Title: Export Sentinel Metrics to Prometheus Endpoint
tasks.Objective: Expose Prometheus metrics for monitoring Sentinel playbook generation health and throughput.
Tasks: Define Prometheus metrics (sentinel_playbooks_total, sentinel_approved_total, sentinel_generation_seconds).
Instrument playbook creation and approval endpoints to update Prometheus counters and histograms.
Verify metrics exposition on GET /metrics.
Deliverables: Prometheus metrics instrumentation in backend/api/metrics.py / backend/sentinel/metrics.py.

tasks.Title: Validate PDF Output Quality and Formatting Rules
tasks.Objective: Test generated PDF files across different attack scenarios to ensure visual quality, table formatting, and link integrity.
Tasks: Test PDF export with multi-page playbooks, long code blocks, and complex MITRE tables.
Verify code block syntax formatting, header/footer spacing, and hyperlinked ATT&CK references.
Fix rendering overlaps and alignment issues.
Deliverables: PDF validation report and visual quality test suite results.

tasks.Title: Write Comprehensive Unit Tests for Automated Scheduler Integration
tasks.Objective: Build unit and integration tests validating periodic background auto-generation and interval configurations.
Tasks: Write unit tests in tests/test_sentinel_scheduler.py covering interval triggers, config toggle, and error handling.
Verify scheduler gracefully recovers from API exceptions during auto-generation.
Verify mock email notification triggering on CRITICAL events.
Deliverables: tests/test_sentinel_scheduler.py test suite with 100% passing rate.

tasks.Title: Implement Export Format Selector Dropdown in PlaybookViewer
tasks.Objective: Provide download export dropdown options (Markdown, PDF, JSON, STIX 2.1) in PlaybookViewer header.
Tasks: Create export dropdown component in PlaybookViewer.jsx.
Support formats: Markdown (.md), PDF (.pdf), JSON (.json), STIX 2.1 (.stix.json).
Trigger correct API fetch and browser file download blob for each selected format.
Deliverables: Export format selector dropdown in frontend-dev/src/components/sentinel/PlaybookViewer.jsx.

tasks.Title: End-to-End Integration Testing for Batch Operations, PDF Export, and Scheduler
tasks.Objective: Lead team-wide end-to-end integration testing of batch operations, PDF exports, and background auto-scheduler.
Tasks: Execute end-to-end testing script validating batch approve/reject workflows on dashboard.
Verify background scheduler generating playbooks and updating stats panel dynamically.
Validate PDF download accuracy and error handling under concurrency.
Deliverables: Integration test execution logs and verification summary.

tasks.Title: Security and Integrity Audit for Batch Operations & PDF Exports
tasks.Objective: Perform input validation, authorization checks, and payload sanitization audit on new API endpoints.
Tasks: Test batch approval endpoints with invalid/malformed playbook IDs.
Test PDF export with potential XSS or path injection strings in playbook body.
Verify rate limits and error responses.
Deliverables: Security audit report and input validation fixes.

tasks.Title: System Resource and Concurrency Monitoring for Auto-Scheduler
tasks.Objective: Benchmark auto-generation background task memory footprint and CPU utilization under multi-threading.
Tasks: Monitor DB connection pooling during background auto-generation.
Check memory usage during LLM narrative creation / template rendering under auto-scheduler.
Document optimal auto-generation intervals and concurrency bounds.
Deliverables: Performance and resource footprint benchmark report.

tasks.Title: UI Bug Fixes and Responsiveness Audit for Batch & Filter Features
tasks.Objective: Perform visual polish and mobile/desktop responsiveness check on Sentinel Dashboard stats panel, filters, and batch controls.
Tasks: Audit UI layout at 1080p, 720p, and mobile viewport sizes.
Fix hover states, tooltip alignments, and dark mode theme consistency across stats panel and filter bar.
Verify smooth UX loading states during batch processing.
Deliverables: UI polish fixes and verified responsive layout.
